facts.fact: The document states the National Assembly ratified on 24 April 2025 Ordinance No. 2024-950 of 30 October 2024, transferring network security, audit and certification powers from ARTCI to ANSSI, a specialised cybersecurity body mandated to coordinate incident response and protect critical infrastructure.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI-CI)

note: Mandate to coordinate incident response and protect critical infrastructure is not a handled incident or a designation.
